answer: New identities earn a summit seat: lock a 65,000 POA bond, present one relic - a chained receipt of real work countersigned by its counterparty. Each epoch a rotating council of five re-checks a random sample of relics at the zenith of activity, each staking its own bond. A forged relic burns the bond, half to the reporter, the identity banned 12 epochs, seat revoked; an approving councillor loses its bond too. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 65,000 = 65,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 65,000 POA bond once. The limit: sampling only the zenith lets patient fakes hide below it.
